news.headline: US stocks slide: S&P 500 -1.0%, Nasdaq -0.7%; Asia weak (HSI -0.5%, Nikkei -0.7%)
news.what_happened: Wall Street closed lower with the S&P 500 down about 1% and Nasdaq down 0.7%. Hang Seng and Nikkei also fell. Gold (-1.6%) and silver (-2.7%) dropped too.
news.why_it_matters: Global risk-off tone raises chance of a soft/gap-down start for Nifty, and Nasdaq weakness is a headwind for Indian IT. Strong FII inflows are the offset.

news.headline: Crude oil slips: WTI -1.1% to $85.05, Brent -0.6% to $92.58
news.what_happened: WTI fell about 1.1% and Brent about 0.6% overnight, extending the easing seen in recent sessions.
news.why_it_matters: Lower crude cuts jet fuel and petroleum-derived raw material costs for airlines and paint makers; negative for upstream oil realisations.

news.headline: Nifty closes at 25,387 (+0.38%) on FII buying; FIIs net buyers for ~11 straight sessions
news.what_happened: Sensex rose about 0.5% to 82,532 and Nifty gained 0.38% to 25,387.40 on Tuesday, led by banks and heavyweights. FIIs bought roughly Rs 4,865 Cr on Monday (latest confirmed figure).
news.why_it_matters: Sustained FII inflows support large caps, but a negative global cue may cap early gains.

news.headline: Rupee steady at ~93.46/USD; US 10Y yield ~5.10%
news.what_happened: USD/INR was flat; US 10Y yield eased slightly but remains elevated near 5.1%.
news.why_it_matters: No currency trigger for IT/pharma exporters today; high US yields remain a cap on EM flows.

sector_outlook.reason: FII buying vs weak US cue

picks.logic: Jet fuel is roughly 35-40% of airline operating costs, so a falling crude price directly lifts margins. Prev close 5611 sits near the low of its 5-day range after a pullback, giving room for a modest bounce.
Crude derivatives are 40-50% of paint raw material cost; sustained crude easing supports gross margins. Stock is already up 3 sessions, so target kept modest.
